summary: A local package inside the same repository as the project but outside its root (a monorepo sibling) was recorded with its absolute checkout path in anchored_local_path, declaring_parent, the ledger owners and the MCP omission fingerprint, so two clones at different paths wrote different lockfiles. It is now recorded relative to the project root with ../ (inside one repository, or with no repository when the two share a parent below /, drive roots, HOME and its parents), and a legacy lock is re-keyed in place once.
